Class: A Guide Through the American Status System - Amazon.com
A comprehensive analysis of American social classes, examining how people's choices in fashion, housing, education, and hobbies reflect their status.

## 

Class: A Guide Through the American Status System
In Class Paul Fussell explodes the sacred American myth of social equality with eagle-eyed irreverence and iconoclastic wit.

## 

Class: A Guide Through the American Status System
Class is guaranteed to amuse and infuriate, whether your class is so high it's out of sight (literally) or you are, alas, a sinking victim of prole drift.
